# singlet.bio

> An open atlas of public single-cell RNA-seq studies from GEO, reprocessed from raw reads with one pipeline. One .singlet file per study holds per-sample count matrices and per-sample QC.

Status: Research Alpha (October 2026), a feedback-oriented research preview. Coverage is partial and some known issues are not fixed yet. Beta, a full re-run, is estimated for Q1 2027. Send feedback from any page of https://singlet.bio.

- Known issues in the Alpha files, and what Beta changes: https://singlet.bio/known-issues
- What's coming in Beta, and the Beta sign-up: https://singlet.bio/beta
- Benchmarks, with Alpha (today's files) and Beta (the re-run engine) kept separate: https://singlet.bio/benchmarking

What Alpha serves: transcriptomics only (gene expression, spliced and unspliced counts, splice junctions). Mitochondrial allele data, genotypes, ancestry, ambient-RNA and doublet calls are not offered in Alpha. Samples below the QC cut-off are flagged and left out of counts and search by default.

## Data

- Study files are served from https://data.singlet.bio. Downloads need no account and no key.
- Python and R clients: https://github.com/Singlet-Bio/singlet (`singlet.load("GSE…")`).
- Each study page: https://singlet.bio/study/<GSE accession>

## API and MCP

- Docs: https://singlet.bio/docs
- Catalog API (JSON): https://singlet.bio/api/search, https://singlet.bio/api/nl-search?q=…, https://singlet.bio/api/gse/<GSE accession>, https://singlet.bio/api/stats
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP): https://singlet.bio/mcp. Setup: https://singlet.bio/docs/mcp. initialize and every tools/call need a free singlet.bio account: sign in when the client asks, or send a personal API key from https://singlet.bio/account. Without one the server answers HTTP 401 (sign_in_required).

- Code (website, catalog API, MCP server, singlet clients): MIT.
- Cite the original GEO study and "Singlet Research Alpha (October 2026)".
